slides.sub: Saturn bias and the cost of waiting.

slides.body: Saturn signifies restraint, fear of loss and delay. A Saturn-heavy money pattern leans toward safety, sometimes more than is useful.
Waiting feels safe, but time is the biggest ingredient in compounding. Over long periods, extreme caution can quietly cost more than a measured risk.
Check Saturn's link to the 2nd house (savings), the 11th (gains) or the Moon. A strong link hints at this caution-first temperament.

points: Define a clear emergency fund, then stop
Invest a fixed small amount on a schedule
Raise it in steps as comfort grows

slides.body: No yoga guarantees wealth. Saturn's caution is also a strength when balanced. This is not financial advice or a stock pick.
